## Done so far

## Next step
Free disk (ENOSPC hit; owner action). Rerun pnpm test and pnpm test:ui. Check a11y.spec.ts "desktop axe: /" failure (maybe rail/fold button). Then tick review 1.3 and PLAN WP1 box, progress.md note (min-width 200 not 220; no expand on drag-over), commit, push, task_complete.

## Open questions
Spec said min-width 220 but that cannot fit five open columns at 1400 px beside the sidebar; used 200.
